scenes.title: Are You Made of Glass?
scenes.summary: On the 18th-century costume-drama film set of L'Enclos, Julie Gayet (playing an aristocrat) and JoeyStarr (playing a servant) clash over a rough embrace in the bushes; director Samir sees they are five days behind schedule and shouts to call their agents immediately.
scenes.location: Plateau du film en costumes L'Enclos (parc d'un château)

scenes.title: Is That the Tax Woman?
scenes.summary: Morning at Andréa's flat after her night with Colette Brancillon; Gabriel calls about a crisis on the movie set, and as Colette leaves down the stairs, Andréa's neighbor Gabriel spots her on the landing and recognizes the tax inspector.
scenes.location: Appartement d'Andréa et palier de l'immeuble

scenes.title: Happy Birthday, Darling!
scenes.summary: On her 23rd birthday, Camille gets calls from her mother and grandmother on the metro and at ASK, chats with Sofia before Sofia leaves for a two-line role opposite JoeyStarr, and receives a purely business envelope from Mathias without a word about her birthday.
scenes.location: Métro parisien puis réception et couloirs d'ASK

scenes.title: Have You Got Stage Fright?
scenes.summary: On the château film set in the countryside, Sofia gets into her 18th-century servant costume, meets JoeyStarr at the coffee table while Julie waits on set, admits she has stage fright, and rehearses her two lines for him.
scenes.location: Loges et table régie sur le tournage au château

scenes.title: I Can't Act Like This!
scenes.summary: JoeyStarr mangles his 18th-century declaration of forbidden love, Julie storms off into her trailer refusing to come out, and JoeyStarr bangs on her door as Andréa and Gabriel arrive on the château set.
scenes.location: Parc du château et devant la loge de Julie Gayet

scenes.title: That Could Win You a César
scenes.summary: Inside Julie Gayet's trailer, Andréa calms Julie down by promising the costume drama could win her a César, while outside in the courtyard JoeyStarr mocks Julie's aristocratic accent and harpsichord lessons to Gabriel and Samir.
scenes.location: Loge de Julie Gayet et cour du château

scenes.title: Like a Magnet
scenes.summary: In JoeyStarr's trailer, JoeyStarr complains to a distracted Gabriel about Julie's snobbery until Gabriel confesses he is drawn like a magnet to a blonde woman who isn't his type, making JoeyStarr realize his own subconscious is clashing with Julie Gayet's.
scenes.location: Loge de JoeyStarr

scenes.title: Gabriel Sarda, My Agent!
scenes.summary: At the catering tent, Sofia proudly introduces Gabriel to another extra as her agent and tells him JoeyStarr praised her rehearsal, before Andréa brings Julie a warm cup of tea and leads her away.
scenes.location: Cantine du tournage dans la cour du château

scenes.title: The Death of Jonathan
scenes.summary: Back at ASK in Paris, Arlette introduces head writer Marie-Sophie Garnier of the daytime soap Heureux pour toujours to Mathias: fed up with arrogant star Jonathan Joubert rewriting scripts for eight years, Marie-Sophie announces they are killing off his character Ryan with testicular cancer.
scenes.location: Bureau de Mathias chez ASK

scenes.title: Send Flowers to Marie-Sophie
scenes.summary: Mathias orders Noémie to send apology flowers to Marie-Sophie signed Jonathan Joubert and ducks into his office to avoid Zinedine Soualem, while Camille and Hervé discuss how devastated Camille's mother and her hairdressing salon will be if Ryan dies.
scenes.location: Open space et couloir des bureaux d'ASK

scenes.title: A Friend in Trouble
scenes.summary: Andréa and Gabriel trick Julie and JoeyStarr into meeting at the château greenhouse, then fake an emergency phone call and lock them inside—only for Julie to fall off a ladder while trying to climb out a window and land right on top of Didier.
scenes.location: Serre du château

scenes.title: Cut!
scenes.summary: In Arlette's office, Arlette tells Mathias that Marie-Sophie rejected his flowers; when Mathias threatens Arlette over her smaller share in ASK without Samuel to protect her, Arlette defends loyalty and dignity, says Marie-Sophie is worth a thousand Jonathan Jouberts, and mimes scissors.
scenes.location: Bureau d'Arlette chez ASK

scenes.title: The Target Is the Woman at the Hairdresser's
scenes.summary: Camille pitches Mathias a grassroots leak targeting hairdressing-salon viewers so fans protest Ryan's death, while Hervé presents a horrifying missing-child-style death notice that Mathias immediately rejects.
scenes.location: Bureau de Mathias chez ASK

scenes.title: We Shoot the Love Scene Tomorrow
scenes.summary: After Julie's fall bruises her backside, Samir tells Andréa and Gabriel they have no choice but to shoot the barn love scene tomorrow; in her room, Julie asks Andréa why films always need love scenes instead of symbolic flowing rivers and frolicking animals.
scenes.location: Couloir et chambre de Julie à l'hôtel de campagne

scenes.title: You're an Animal, Didier
scenes.summary: In JoeyStarr's hotel room, Didier admits to Gabriel that he feels self-conscious about his weight and doesn't know how 18th-century aristocrats and servants made love; Gabriel tells him to do what comes naturally until Didier tells him to stop looking at him like that.
scenes.location: Chambre de JoeyStarr à l'hôtel de campagne

scenes.title: Messages at Reception
scenes.summary: At the hotel reception desk, Gabriel teases Andréa about the receptionist before Andréa checks her messages by phone with Camille and wishes Camillette a happy birthday.
scenes.location: Réception et escalier de l'hôtel de campagne

scenes.title: Surprise in Room Sixteen
scenes.summary: Colette Brancillon surprises Andréa inside her country hotel room; in Paris Camille launches an online Save Ryan petition with her mother, and back at the hotel Andréa slips away from dinner with Gabriel to tend to Colette after Colette slips in the shower.
scenes.location: Chambre 16 de l'hôtel de campagne et appartement de Camille

scenes.title: Someone Important Forgot
scenes.summary: Over kidneys at the hotel restaurant, Gabriel and Andréa reflect on how little the agents know about each other's lives; in Paris, Hippolyte brings Camille a midnight birthday cake, and Camille confesses that someone important to her forgot her 23rd birthday.
scenes.location: Restaurant de l'hôtel de campagne et appartement de Camille

scenes.title: CEO of ASK
scenes.summary: In bed at home, Catherine reveals she convinced her father to lend her the money to buy out Samuel's shares at ASK, making Mathias CEO—and they dream together about expanding ASK with writer-director, image-management, and production departments.
scenes.location: Chambre de Mathias et Catherine

scenes.title: She's Not Right for You
scenes.summary: Hearing a noise downstairs at night, Mathias catches Hippolyte taking wine from his cellar; learning Hippolyte is seeing Camille, Mathias panics and lies to his son that Camille cannot be trusted because she has a suit-and-tie boyfriend at the agency.
scenes.location: Cuisine de la maison de Mathias et Catherine

scenes.title: Dinner for Two in Room Sixteen
scenes.summary: At the hotel reception the next morning, Gabriel helps the receptionist with her billing software and spots dinner for two and champagne charged to room 16; he barges into Andréa's room with breakfast and demands to know who is hiding in her bathroom.
scenes.location: Réception de l'hôtel puis chambre 16 d'Andréa

scenes.title: Stop the Car!
scenes.summary: Driving to the set, Gabriel explodes when he learns Andréa is sleeping with tax inspector Colette Brancillon, causing Andréa to stop the car and storm off on foot in the countryside—while in Paris Camille's Save Ryan petition hits over 10,000 signatures overnight and wins Mathias's praise.
scenes.location: Voiture de Gabriel en campagne et bureau de Mathias chez ASK

scenes.title: Sofia's Scene Is Cut
scenes.summary: Andréa arrives at the château on a farmer's tractor; meanwhile in the courtyard, the assistant director announces that Sofia's Scene 60 with JoeyStarr has been cut due to schedule delays, leaving Sofia heartbroken as she assumes JoeyStarr didn't want to act with her.
scenes.location: Cour du château sur le tournage de L'Enclos

scenes.title: An Insect! Fire!
scenes.summary: In the candlelit barn, Samir clears the set to shoot Julie and Didier's 18th-century love scene in the hay; after stiff early takes, an insect in the hay makes Didier knock over a candle, setting the barn on fire—and after Didier rescues Julie from the smoke, their passion ignites for real.
scenes.location: Grange du château éclairée aux bougies

scenes.title: Are You Really a Couple?
scenes.summary: Driving back toward Paris, Gabriel and Andréa discuss Colette's cracked rib and Gabriel's pile of restaurant receipts; Andréa admits that she and Colette are truly a couple now and asks Gabriel not to tell anyone at the agency.
scenes.location: Voiture de Gabriel sur la route du retour vers Paris

scenes.title: The Financing Plan and the Agenda
scenes.summary: Catherine confirms the lawyer meeting with her father to finalize the buyout package and reminds Mathias they have the opera tonight; the next morning at ASK, the assistants wonder why Mathias has called an urgent meeting.
scenes.location: Salon de Mathias et Catherine puis open space d'ASK

scenes.title: ASK Will Not Be Sold
scenes.summary: Mathias announces to Andréa, Gabriel, and Arlette that ASK will not be sold because he is buying Samuel's shares with his wife's money; Andréa and Gabriel fume in the hallway over Mathias taking control until Samir calls in a panic because Julie Gayet and JoeyStarr have vanished.
scenes.location: Bureau de Mathias puis couloir d'ASK

scenes.title: The Call About Spielberg
scenes.summary: Hervé tricks Julie into answering her phone with a fake voicemail about Steven Spielberg in Paris, allowing Gabriel and Andréa to track Julie and Didier to a luxury spa hotel, stop Didier from attacking a paparazzo, and bring them back to the set for a passionate final take.
scenes.location: Bureaux d'ASK, hôtel-spa de campagne et plateau du château

scenes.title: Comforting Sofia
scenes.summary: On the Heureux pour toujours set, Jonathan Joubert throws a tantrum over Ryan crying and insults the director until Mathias snaps and drops him as a client on the spot; back at ASK that evening, Gabriel comforts Sofia over her cut scene and invites her to dinner, agreeing to use tu.
scenes.location: Plateau de la série Heureux pour toujours puis réception d'ASK

scenes.title: I Have Something to Tell You
scenes.summary: Late at night at ASK, Mathias apologizes to Camille for forgetting her birthday and opens champagne with her to celebrate her petition; when Catherine and Hippolyte arrive after Mathias missed the opera, Hippolyte suspects Mathias is having an affair with Camille—forcing Mathias to tell Catherine the truth.
scenes.location: Bureau de Mathias et couloir d'ASK la nuit
